description: Fires mostly when column 1 (second from left) is completely empty, the bottom of column 2 is empty or mine (not the opponent's), and the opponent has stones stacked in the centre (column 3/4), often with a second empty column further right. An opponent stone at the bottom of column 1 or 2 switches it off. Weaker firing in the threshold band is mixed (late-game deep empty wells) and not captured well.
effect: None measurable: forcing it high or to zero changes move probabilities by at most about 0.1 (slight shifts between columns 2, 3 and 4, no consistent direction).
notes: 7 dev calls. Best F1 0.194 (P 0.14, R 0.31, AUROC 0.63) for col1-empty & (0,2) not theirs & col3 height>=2; plain col1-empty had AUROC 0.68 but F1 0.165. Wells, parity-by-phase, right-side-hole variants all scored lower. Minimal pairs are consistent for the top regime (O at bottom of col 1/2 kills; color swap and mirror kill), but activation also depends on who moved first and on move order, so the unit looks like a mixture. Simulation share ~0. Synthesis reaches 16.6 vs dev max 13.7.
